summary.name: Reading Coach
summary.one_liner: Reading Coach is a free Microsoft reading practice tool that uses AI-generated stories and leveled ReadWorks passages to help learners build literacy skills.
use_cases: Work on challenging words within story chapters
Track a learner's reading progress over time
Let educators guide students' reading practice
Build reading confidence for emerging readers or learners with dyslexia
Read leveled library passages in multiple languages
summary.what_it_does: Reading Coach lets learners create stories with AI and read them, along with library passages from ReadWorks, in many languages. It detects pronunciation in multiple English dialects. Learners practice challenging words woven into story chapters and unlock new characters, settings, and achievements as they read. Educators can guide student practice and track progress. The page says it uses Immersive Reader and content aligned to Microsoft's Responsible AI standards. The app is described as working for learners who can already decode words.
notable: AI-generated stories with challenging words woven into chapters
Pronunciation detection in multiple English dialects
Educators can guide practice and track progress; school login supported
caveats: Designed for learners who already know how to decode words
Windows app is listed; other platforms are not named on the page
